title: Trevor Grassi's corridor of rooms leading to the tunnel network
place_text: Giza Plateau, near the shafts between Khafre and the Sphinx, Egypt

tellings.quote: 100 m far away from these shafts and he found and he found a so-called corridor of rooms.

plain: About 100 metres from the shafts that sit between the Khafre pyramid and the Sphinx at Giza, a man named Trevor Grassi is said to have found what he called "a corridor of rooms" leading toward a network of tunnels under the plateau. The scientist Filippo Biondi, who scans beneath the pyramids with radar, tells Michels this as something Grassi found, not something he saw himself. If it were true, the hidden spaces under Giza would reach well beyond the monuments.
